preconditions.expression: len(stdin) > 0 and all(c.isdigit() for c in stdin)
preconditions.description: The input is a non-empty string of digits.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly one '+' and one '='.
Removing '+' and '=' from the output results in the original input string.

postconditions.expression: all(part[0] != '0' or len(part) == 1 for part in stdout.split('='))
postconditions.description: Neither 'a', 'b', nor 'c' has leading zeros unless it is '0'.
